_doc: Canonical registry of every gem5 build SimSpect runs against. ONE entry per distinct build tree. Each build = a different defense implementation; gem5 is ground truth. 'timing_hooks' records whether the build carries the two window-realizing hooks SimSpect needs: branch_force (--branch-ann-file BTB override + per-branch resolve-stall) and fnc_commit_stall (hold the first-not-committed insn at the ROB head, 150 cyc). 'status' summarizes hook coverage. Source: wiki/design/MODELS_AND_BUILDS.md + METHODS_INSTRUMENTATION.md + gem5-hooks/README.md + AMULET_BUGS_DETECTION_ACCOUNTING.md. Viewed in the dashboard Utilities > gem5 builds tab.

timing_hook_legend.branch_force: --branch-ann-file BTB override (force branch direction) + per-branch resolve-stall. Realizes the modeled mispredict + holds the branch unresolved. Vanilla builds reject --branch-ann-file.
timing_hook_legend.fnc_commit_stall: fncCommitStallPC/Cycles — stalls commit of the first-not-committed insn at the ROB head (recon/STT use 150 cyc), widening the speculative window so the slow VP/squash cases land in-window.
timing_hook_legend.status_values: full = both hooks present; base-control = intentionally un-hooked baseline; none = not instrumented
